selection.name: Acid Spray
selection.description: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases damage per second by a multiplier of 1.5 and armor reduction by a multiplier of 1.5.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Turns Acid Spray into a passive that automatically applies at the center of the arena when the battle begins. The Acid Spray takes up the entire arena and lasts for the entire battle.

selection.name: Ancient Seal
selection.description: The caster seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Also applies Ancient Seal on a random enemy in 700 radius around the main target.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Reduces cooldown by 8 seconds, increases magic resistance reduction by 16%, and refills 100% of the caster's mana when the target dies while afflicted with Ancient Seal's debuff.
